scope: Independent resumed-task review of the already completed distributed files. Exact atlas pixels preserved; no pet lifecycle mutation.

visual_review.method: Native-size labeled direction inspection and ordered animation-frame contact sheet; supplemented by an isolated normal-size axis blind review. Local encoded previews exist; native ChatGPT/Dot playback was not tested.
visual_review.nine_states: All required states retain the same character identity, connected tail and complete frames. Running left/right have correctly facing alternating poses. Idle blinks; jumping lifts and returns; working/review/waiting remain distinct.
visual_review.four_cardinals: All four are supported by existing three-reviewer majority and supplementary isolated review; no cardinal mismatch or ambiguity found.
visual_review.intermediate_directions: Weak head-pitch cues remain around nearly horizontal and near-cardinal steps. Current labeled loop review found no wrong-quadrant pose or visible backtracking; these are approximate directional poses, not precise eye-tracking calibration.

provenance_audit.historical_process_scope: Fingerprints and retained input/output pixels were checked. The exact historical generation path, number of successful executions and lack of mirroring remain documented production history, not facts independently proved from image hashes.

candidate_decisions.v1: Usable nine-state compatibility candidate for an entrypoint that accepts the v1 contract; actual GUI import and runtime behavior remain untested.
candidate_decisions.v2: Usable optional extended candidate only for an entrypoint that explicitly accepts v2, with the documented approximate diagonal-gaze limitations.
